recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR-35936. Do not re-add source/async-bulk.html or source/async-bundle.html under this seed; handle broken API Incubator links or any future move of the detailed pattern text through unresolved follow-up issues such as FHIR-53868 after final FHIR-I disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-35936 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core async.html. It requested alignment with Bulk Data IG community work by splitting the async page into a FMM 4 bulk export pattern and a lower-maturity asynchronous interaction pattern, completing async-bundle content, removing bulk-specific wording from async-bundle, and marking async-bundle FMM 1.
initial_application: Git commit 440a91ad3fc960eac116920548e0f3b2e3539aca, 'split and update async page per FHIR-35936,' added source/async-bulk.html and source/async-bundle.html, registered both pages in publish.ini, left source/async.html as the overview, marked async-bulk FMM 4, and marked async-bundle FMM 1.
additional_context: Commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd later removed source/async-bulk.html and source/async-bundle.html from the current core build and changed source/async.html to link to API Incubator details while implementation testing continues. Related async issues FHIR-47271, FHIR-47273, FHIR-47276, and FHIR-47278 are already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-53868 tracks the currently broken API Incubator async-bundle link, but it is Triaged/Unresolved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active build-scope core source is source/async.html, and it currently lists the two async patterns, distinguishes bulk data from asynchronous interaction use cases, points to the API Incubator details, and includes the later _outputFormat disambiguation rule. Reintroducing deleted detail pages for this seed would reverse a later R6 structural change.
